message:
I fixed `calc.py` in two places: `add` now returns `a + b` instead of `a - b`, and `div` returns `None` when `b` is 0. Both tests pass (`2 passed`), run through `uv run --with pytest` because pytest isn't installed in the project venv.

Skipped: I didn't install pytest into the venv. `div` returns `None` on a zero divisor because the test requires it, which hides the error from callers.

log.command: cd /tmp/mc-demo && cat calc.py test_calc.py && python -m pytest -q 2>&1 | tail -20

cd /tmp/mc-demo && cat > calc.py <<'E'
def add(a, b):
    return a + b


def div(a, b):
    return None if b == 0 else a / b
E
(python -m pytest -q || python3 -m pytest -q || uv run --with pytest pytest -q) 2>&1 | tail -8
